title: Stationary Strings XIV: Two Proposed Benchtop Tests (Viscoelastic Vortex PIV and Sodium-22 Positronium) and Vela Pulsar Glitch Observations
description: Third link of the Stationary Strings series (October 2026): benchtop Burgers-vortex PIV predictions for a 100 ppm PEO solution with the locked saturation factor C_univ, together with a two-regime laminar versus elastic-turbulence resistance bridge based on the Theorems IX-X factor S_loss = 19.7511425 that covers the measured flow-resistance increase 12-19 to 97.9 percent (Theorem XIV.1, Test T35), Vela pulsar glitch amplitude with source-verified inputs giving 0.43 percent agreement with the 2004 event and a measured healing fraction Q_2000 = 0.02198 (Theorem XIV.2, Test T36), and a positronium Na-22 band ratio 0.08413579 that refutes the published and the pole-substituted Ore-Powell forms at 2.4e6 sigma in one hour of HPGe counting (Theorem XIV.3, Test T37), plus an independent 15-point cross-check. Full paper in Turkish and English. Tests T35-T37 run with the solver in the Paper V repository (stationary-strings-v).
